UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $p='{{ElasticPassword}}'; if (-not $p) { exit 0 }; $env:ES_PATH_CONF='{{$FullBaseDir}}config'; $p | & '{{$FullBaseDir}}es\bin\elasticsearch-keystore.bat' add -x -f bootstrap.password; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'Failed to store the elastic password in the keystore'; exit 1 }; Write-Output 'Stored the elastic password in the keystore'"

-c "P='{{ElasticPassword}}'; [[ -z $P ]] && exit 0; printf '%s\n' \"$P\" | ES_PATH_CONF='{{$FullBaseDir}}config' '{{$FullBaseDir}}es/bin/elasticsearch-keystore' add -x -f bootstrap.password || { echo 'Failed to store the elastic password in the keystore'; exit 1; }; echo 'Stored the elastic password in the keystore'"
